name: CumpliTax
country_of_origin: Peru — the official homepage calls CumpliTax a "software peruano"; its official LinkedIn page lists Lima, Peru as headquarters, and the Terms are governed by Peruvian law. Legal/brand operator stated as MBP TC LLC.
founded_year: unknown — no founding year is stated on the official product, legal, privacy, or company pages reviewed.
type: Tax-compliance and accounts-payable evidence SaaS for Peru: automated electronic payment receipt/XML validation, supplier-document collection, tax-document evidence management, audit trail, and ERP/API integration.
target_customer: Corporate finance, accounts-payable, accounting, and tax teams that process high volumes of supplier invoices/CPEs; suppliers upload or email XML and supporting documents through a customer portal. The positioning is enterprise/corporate rather than freelancer bookkeeping.
credit_tax_invoice_validation: yes — company-positioned as automatic credit-tax eligibility/validity screening, not merely a basic XML check: it claims to validate XML structure/content, SUNAT CPE status, issuer RUC condition/status, and apply 140+ internal revalidation rules; it says validated evidence supports correct use of credit fiscal. It also warns that "Aceptado en SUNAT" alone does not make a cost/expense deductible. No public evidence of a routine per-invoice human accountant review; final professional judgment remains with the customer.
electronic_invoicing: yes — validates and stores electronic payment receipts/CPEs in XML and related evidence; the public material does not show that CumpliTax itself issues invoices.
sunat_xml_download: unknown — official material says suppliers upload or email XML/documents to the portal and that CumpliTax validates against SUNAT; it does not publicly state that the product downloads XML in bulk from SUNAT.
sire: yes — the official company LinkedIn page markets an SIRE module for reviewing the purchase register, comparing the SUNAT proposal with company data, identifying observations, and preparing a replacement TXT. This is a company claim from LinkedIn, not independently tested.
ple: yes — official LinkedIn updates say users can load the PLE purchase register as part of the SIRE comparison workflow and generate a replacement TXT. This does not establish a standalone PLE filing product.
tax_declarations: unknown — no verified public evidence of preparation or filing of monthly/annual tax returns; SIRE/PLE register controls should not be treated as tax-return filing.
ai_ocr: unknown — search metadata describes validation "mediante IA," but the readable official product page does not specify OCR or document-image extraction; no verified AI-OCR feature claim is retained.
bulk_entry_upload: unknown — portal/email receipt of XML and supporting documents is documented, but the public pages do not say that invoice data can be bulk-entered or batch-uploaded. SIRE/PLE proposal loading is a separate, narrower claim.
multi_ruc: unknown — the subscription UI asks for a RUC and displays pricing per "entidad legal," but no public page explicitly confirms multi-RUC tenancy or switching across several RUCs.
mobile_app: unknown — no public evidence of native iOS/Android apps; the documented interface is a web portal and email intake.
whatsapp: yes — the official homepage exposes a WhatsApp contact link (+51 941 138 443). This verifies a contact channel only; it does not verify WhatsApp document ingestion or automated support.
automation_and_human_review: Automatic validation is explicitly claimed: portal/SUNAT checks plus 140+ internal rules, cross-checks against purchase order, SAP MIGO/MIRO/HES, electronic dispatch guide, and other receipt evidence, with timestamped results and ERP webhooks/REST API. Human-in-the-loop: no public statement says an accountant manually reviews every invoice; the Terms explicitly say CumpliTax is a support tool that does not replace the user’s professional judgment and makes the user responsible for document authenticity.
pricing_and_per_ruc: Public pricing is embedded on the live homepage, but it is not priced per client RUC in the Aldía sense. Displayed basis is number of users per legal entity, in USD/month, with monthly and annual options: 100 users = $125 monthly or $113 annual; 3,000 users = $917 monthly or $827 annual; 21 tiers are shown from 100 to 3,000 users, and >3,000 is handled by contact/demo. The page does not publish taxes, implementation fees, overage terms, or a per-RUC price. Source: https://www.cumplitax.com/#Precios
size_signals: Official LinkedIn company page reports 58 followers, 11–50 employees, partnership type, and Lima headquarters. These are self-reported platform signals, not audited customer, revenue, funding, or team counts; no customer/funding numbers were found.
claims_vs_independent_evidence: Company claims: the official site claims automatic XML/content, SUNAT-status, and RUC checks; 140+ internal rules; timestamped supplier evidence; cross-checks to PO/SAP MIGO-MIRO-HES/electronic dispatch guides; and ERP webhooks/REST API. The official LinkedIn page additionally claims SIRE and PLE/TXT workflows, 3-way matching, and blocking differences before ERP registration. Independent/regulatory corroboration: SUNAT’s official CPE consultation page confirms that a basic SUNAT validity query checks whether a CPE is registered/informed using issuer RUC, document type, recipient ID, number, date, and total; it does not validate CumpliTax’s 140+ rules, evidentiary sufficiency, or credit-tax eligibility. No independent product review, customer case study, or third-party performance test was verified.
freshness_or_status: Live/current signals: the official site, pricing flow, legal pages, and login domain resolve; the official blog index shows a 06.10.26 post analyzing 149 Tribunal Fiscal resolutions, and LinkedIn currently displays SIRE/PLE and 3-way-match updates. Terms and privacy pages show last update October 2025, so those legal disclosures may lag newer product marketing. No dead official URL was encountered; the alternate login domain https://cumplitax.net/ is live and states MBP TC LLC ownership.

founded_year: 2014 start of activities, not necessarily the legal founding date: UniversidadPeru reports 01-Feb-2014 and DatosPeru reports 31-Jan-2014. This was not verified on an official company page.
type: Cloud ERP + CRM, with stated POS, e-commerce, inventory/logistics, accounting/finance, HR/payroll, production and AI-agent capabilities.
target_customer: PYMEs and growing industrial, commercial, distribution and service businesses, especially those with multiple warehouses/sites, production, sales teams, credit/collections or interconnected accounting. Official pages focus on Peru and also mention Colombia.
credit_tax_invoice_validation: unknown / not verified as an Aldía-equivalent automatic crédito fiscal eligibility check. electronic_invoicing: yes — official pricing/product pages claim direct SUNAT integration; issuance of invoices, receipts, credit/debit notes, service/export/special-operation invoicing, electronic summaries, cancellations, contingencies and resends.
sunat_xml_download: unknown — an official AI-accounting page mentions PDF, XML and CDR evidence when applicable, but I found no explicit public statement that users can download SUNAT XML files. The SIRE page explicitly mentions downloading differences in XLS, not XML.
sire: yes — official materials place SIRE in the ERP workflow and describe consulting SUNAT proposals, comparing RVIE/RCE with ERP purchases/sales, detecting differences and missing documents, reviewing fiscal/non-fiscal observations, re-comparing, and accepting/complementing/replacing as appropriate.
ple: unknown — PLE is mentioned as part of the Peru accounting/tax context, but no dedicated public product specification or workflow was verified. An independent RUC directory shows the company itself as not affiliated to PLE ('-'); that is not a definitive statement about product capability.
tax_declarations: unknown — SIRE/RVIE/RCE and SUNAT-linked accounting are documented, but I found no explicit public claim for general automated tax-declaration filing beyond those records.
payroll_plame: yes — official HR/payroll page says iSiore GO includes payroll processes and reports related to AFPNet and PLAME, subject to the implemented scope/configuration; it also connects worker data, attendance, payroll, cost centers and accounting.
bank_reconciliation: yes — the official homepage lists a Conciliación Bancaria AI agent and describes payments, banks and reconciliations in the financial workflow. Public material does not specify bank-feed coverage, matching rules or exception handling in detail.
ai_ocr: unknown — AI agents and PDF/XML/CDR evidence are claimed, but no public product page verified OCR ingestion or invoice-image OCR.
bulk_entry_upload: unknown — the SIRE article describes avoiding dependence on manually built TXT/ZIP/Excel files and says differences can be downloaded as XLS, but it does not document a general bulk-import/upload feature.
multi_ruc: unknown — unlimited branches, warehouses and additional user licenses are stated, but I found no verified claim for managing multiple client RUCs/companies under one account. Do not equate multi-site with multi-RUC.
white_label: unknown — no public white-label/reseller branding capability found.
mobile_app: yes — the official services-ERP page claims mobile tools/an app for field teams, including time registration, document/contract access, remote updates and synchronization. No app-store listing or accounting-mobile scope was verified.
whatsapp: yes — official CRM page claims WhatsApp, email and SMS campaigns, automated responses and bots for first-line attention, connected to CRM/ERP sales workflows.
automation_and_human_review: Human-in-the-loop is explicit. The AI accounting agent is described as non-autonomous: it registers/classifies/validates repetitive operations, while adjustments, exceptions, sensitive validations and professional judgment remain with the accounting team. For SIRE, the official page says acceptance is a decision by the responsible person after reviewing the period; approval/workflow roles are also described. This is stronger evidence of assisted automation than of unattended tax validation.
pricing_and_per_ruc: Public plan pricing is monthly per plan/company, not stated per client RUC: Pyme $150/month + IGV; Empresa Digital $200; Premium $400; Inteligente $450. Pricing page says 3 users included, unlimited branches/warehouses and extra licenses/add-ons; POS and AI add-ons are each shown at $60/month. Implementation is separately quoted/listed at $7,159, $15,760 and $35,891 (without IGV) for named tiers. Per-RUC pricing is not stated. Freshness/caution: the homepage shows conflicting annual figures (e.g., $1,080 annual for the $150 plan) while the pricing page shows $1,620 annual; neither reconciles mathematically to 12 months, so confirm current commercial terms.
size_signals: Legal entity signal: ISIORE E.I.R.L., RUC 20559836584, active, Peru; independent directories report a 2014 activity start. No verified public customer count, funding, team size, ARR or market-share figure. DatosPeru displays a worker-history table, but the extracted presentation is ambiguous, so no employee number is asserted. UniversidadPeru reports zero public evaluations on its directory page.
claims_vs_independent_evidence: Company claims: official iSiore pages substantiate the ERP/CRM positioning, Peru/Colombia market, modules, SUNAT electronic invoicing, SIRE comparison, AI-assisted accounting, WhatsApp, mobile tools and PLAME/AFPNet scope. Independent corroboration: UniversidadPeru and DatosPeru agree on RUC 20559836584, ISIORE E.I.R.L. legal form and Peru location; UniversidadPeru reports February 2014 activity start and DatosPeru January 2014. RUC.pe also reports the active Peruvian EIRL. No independent product review with usable technical detail was found; the fetched YouTube review page exposed no transcript. An independent directory’s 'manual' electronic-emission/system fields and PLE '-' are registry signals that may be stale or refer to the legal entity, not the SaaS product, and should not override current product pages.
freshness_or_status: The official site is active: homepage, pricing, HR/CRM/service pages and multiple SIRE/ERP articles were accessible; search results show 2026-dated posts including January, February, March and October 2026. The official tutorials page lists WhatsApp and AI tutorials but no dates. Status caveats are the inconsistent annual pricing between homepage and pricing page, and third-party registry fields that may be outdated relative to current product marketing. No dead official URL was relied on for a positive claim; two guessed accounting URLs returned no extractable content.

type: Cloud/SaaS ERP and integrated business-management platform covering sales/POS, inventory, logistics, accounting, electronic invoicing, payroll, production and reporting.
target_customer: Peruvian PYMES/SMEs, especially product-selling businesses such as minimarkets and bodegas, boticas/pharmacies, distributors, ferreterías, food/furniture manufacturers, retailers and other multi-location operations.
credit_tax_invoice_validation: Only basic SUNAT/accounting/format checks are evidenced; full automatic crédito fiscal invoice-eligibility validation is not verified. electronic_invoicing: yes — official pages claim direct SUNAT electronic issuance for facturas, boletas, credit/debit notes and GRE, with automatic sending, offline queue/synchronization and SUNAT status/history. This is primarily company-reported.
sunat_xml_download: yes — the invoicing page says each document retains XML and CDR for consultation, download and audit; it also says PDF+XML can be sent automatically by WhatsApp/email.
sire: yes — official SIRE material claims automatic generation/validation of sales and purchase records, including RUC/series/date checks, followed by TXT download and manual upload to SUNAT Virtual. Direct electronic filing is not verified.
ple: yes — official pages claim one-click automatic PLE generation, accounting-balance/format checks and TXT output for Diario, Mayor, Ventas, Compras and other books; the user still downloads and uploads files to SUNAT Virtual manually.
tax_declarations: unknown — SIRE/PLE reports and TXT exports are documented, but direct preparation/submission of tax declarations or payment filings is not verified.
payroll_plame: yes — official solutions/pricing pages advertise payroll, T-Registro and PLAME integration/export. Whether iGEA files PLAME directly or only prepares/export data is not stated.
bank_reconciliation: yes — the official accounting page claims automatic bank-versus-system matching by date, amount and reference, with alerts for missing/unapplied/unreconciled items. Implementation details and independent corroboration are not available.
ai_ocr: unknown — no public invoice-OCR or AI document-capture feature was found. The company describes AI-assisted software development, which is not OCR.
bulk_entry_upload: yes — general bulk/data import is documented: FAQ says clients, products and transactions can be imported; pricing lists Excel, CSV and API import/export. A dedicated bulk received-invoice-entry workflow is not explicitly documented.
multi_ruc: yes — the accounting page explicitly states separate accounting by RUC, independent PLE per company and consolidated group reporting. Maximum RUC count and any per-RUC pricing are not stated.
white_label: unknown — no public white-label, reseller or customer-branded deployment offering was found.
mobile_app: yes — the ERP is described as responsive/mobile and multiplatform; an official Android listing exists for iGEA APP. The Play listing shows 100+ downloads, but current app scope/version details are limited.
whatsapp: yes — WhatsApp is advertised for support, and the invoicing page says PDF+XML invoices can be sent automatically through WhatsApp; the Android listing also advertises sales via WhatsApp.
automation_and_human_review: Automation is strongly claimed for issuance, SUNAT transmission, RUC/series/date checks, accounting entries, SIRE/PLE generation and bank matching. Human-in-the-loop evidence is limited to human technical support and the option for an external accountant to review exported Excel data and record adjustments; no public evidence shows mandatory or per-invoice accountant review, especially for crédito fiscal eligibility.
pricing_and_per_ruc: Current official price: S/ 240/month, IGV included, or S/ 2,400/year (pay 10 months/use 12; two months free). Users, branches and electronic documents are advertised as unlimited; migration, training and support are included; no per-user, module or document fee is stated. Operations above 100 branches or 50,000 monthly transactions require infrastructure quotation. A per-client-RUC fee is not stated; accounting supports separate RUCs.
size_signals: iGEA claims more than 500 active companies in Peru (official company pages). The LinkedIn profile lists company size 2–10 employees and the Google Play listing shows 100+ downloads; these are profile/store signals, not audited customer or employee counts. No funding or revenue figure was found.
claims_vs_independent_evidence: Company claims: Peru-focused ERP, direct SUNAT/no-PSE architecture, GAMP5, >500 active companies, automated compliance/reporting and the S/240 plan are stated on iGEA's own pages. External corroboration: LinkedIn identifies iGEA as a cloud ERP for Peruvian businesses, links it to Diseño y Sistemas Peru EIRL and lists Lima; Google Play confirms an iGEA Android app published by Diseño y Sistemas Perú E.I.R.L.; DYS Peru's separate product page corroborates cloud ERP, SUNAT e-invoicing, purchases, multi-device access and direct integration. DYS appears related because it carries the same operator/copyright, so it is not fully independent. No independent source verified full crédito fiscal eligibility automation, customer count, GAMP5 certification, technical direct-SUNAT architecture or current price.
freshness_or_status: Official site appears active: pricing says prices are valid to September 2026; the PSE article was updated 12 February 2026 and the PLE article is dated 1 March 2026. Status conflicts/stale signals: the homepage contains both an old-looking '8+ years' badge and newer '13+ years' copy; Google Play still advertises S/120 versus the official 2026 S/240 price and shows only 100+ downloads; LinkedIn lists 2015 founding versus the official 2013 claim. founded_year: unknown — no sourced founding year found.
type: Cloud accounting software and companion mobile app for Peru; accounting, electronic books, SUNAT/SIRE connectivity, payroll, tax reports and study/accountant management.
target_customer: Accounting firms/studios and accountants managing multiple client companies, plus Peruvian businesses; the site explicitly offers a Panel de Estudio Contable and controls/assigns client companies to assistants.

SUNAT states credit-fiscal eligibility also requires substantive conditions (cost/gasto and taxable use), IGV separately stated, authorized issuer, and Purchase-Register recording; ContaUno does not state that it automatically evaluates all of these.
electronic_invoicing: unknown — electronic-receipt handling is yes (PDF/XML/CDR capture/import and SUNAT validation), but direct electronic-invoice issuance/emission by ContaUno is not stated on the reviewed pages.
sunat_xml_download: unknown — the privacy policy says the mobile app can read electronic-receipt PDF/XML/CDR attachments and the product extracts SIRE proposals, but no explicit SUNAT XML download/export feature was found.
sire: yes — API/SUNAT connection; extracts sales and purchase proposals, automatically creates entries, and produces SIRE electronic purchase/sales books.
ple: yes — produces PLE electronic Journal, Major and Simplified Journal books.
tax_declarations: yes — supports preparation/reporting: IGV/Renta tax-liquidation reports and SUNAT books; however, direct automatic filing/submission of Form 621 was not verified. ContaUno's own explanatory page describes reviewing data, entering SUNAT, submitting and paying as user steps.
payroll_plame: yes — payroll module calculates payroll items and exports TXT for bulk PLAME-SUNAT loading; direct submission to PLAME is not stated.
bank_reconciliation: unknown — Caja y Bancos, banking/deductions and related reports are stated, but an explicit bank-reconciliation workflow/matching feature was not found.
ai_ocr: unknown — the app scans/photos receipts and extracts data, but AI/OCR terminology is not stated; describe this as automated document extraction rather than verified AI.
bulk_entry_upload: yes — bulk Excel import for purchases/sales, bulk payroll Excel loading, and bulk SIRE-file validation; migration from another system is also claimed.
multi_ruc: yes — multi-company/accounting support: public tiers cover 1 company, up to 50 companies and unlimited accounting; the study panel assigns companies/carteras. A per-RUC billing model is not stated.
white_label: unknown — no white-label/reseller branding feature found.
mobile_app: yes — official privacy policy lists ContaUno mobile for Android/iOS; product pages describe photo capture, extraction and SUNAT validation, and Google Play lists the app. The homepage simultaneously labels the app 'Proximamente', an apparent stale/inconsistent signal.
whatsapp: yes — feature page says customers can send digitized purchases/PDF/Excel via WhatsApp and reports can be sent to the accountant; the terms/privacy policy clarify user-initiated/manual sharing and do not evidence autonomous WhatsApp sending.
automation_and_human_review: yes — automation is claimed for entries, SIRE proposal processing, payroll calculations, document extraction and SUNAT checks. size_signals: Company claim only: homepage says it has 'miles de clientes' across Peru. External Google Play listing shows 100+ downloads for the mobile app. No verified customer total, funding, employee/team count or revenue found.
claims_vs_independent_evidence: Company claims: official ContaUno pages claim cloud accounting, automated entries, SIRE/PLE books, SUNAT validity checking, study-panel multi-company management, payroll/PLAME exports, mobile scanning and the three public plan prices. Proximamente' banner conflicts with the detailed app feature page, privacy policy and live Google Play listing, so app availability/status should be treated as an inconsistent or possibly stale site signal.
